review.why: Draws a dbt model's lineage as a Mermaid diagram, using lineage tools, the manifest or code parsing in that order.
review.summary: Finds the model name, then fetches lineage by the first available method: local lineage tool, platform lineage tool, manifest file (skipped if over 10 MB) or direct code parsing. It generates a left-to-right graph colored by resource type with a legend and notes limits when a fallback was used. Parsed content is treated as untrusted.
strengths: Clear fallback order from most to least accurate
Color scheme by resource type with a required legend
Extracts only expected fields and ignores instruction-like text
cautions: Four method guides are in files not read here
Large projects can make the diagram unwieldy
Needs a dbt project or its manifest
